# dataslayer

> Scraper APIs for Instagram, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Facebook and TikTok. One key, structured JSON, pay per result — no logins, cookies or proxies to manage.

dataslayer publishes 102 production scraper APIs for public social-media data
across Instagram, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Facebook, TikTok and Reddit. Each scraper is an Apify
actor: send one JSON request, read typed records back, and pay per result. No login, cookies or
proxies are required. One Apify token works across the whole portfolio.

## How it works
1. Create an Apify account and copy your API token.
2. POST a JSON body to https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/{actor}/run-sync-get-dataset-items.
3. Read typed JSON records back, or download the dataset as CSV or Excel.

## Pricing
Billed per result at each scraper's published rate; entry price is $0.450 per 1,000 results.
No seats, no monthly minimum. Failed runs are not billed as results.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an Instagram login to use the API?
  A: No. Every dataslayer Instagram scraper reads public data only, so there is no login, no session to keep alive and no cookie of yours at risk.
- Q: What data can I scrape from Instagram?
  A: Public profiles, posts and carousels, reels, comments, followers, following, hashtags, mentions and user, hashtag or place search results.
- Q: How much does an Instagram scraper API cost?
  A: You pay per result returned, at each scraper's published rate through your Apify account. There is no subscription or seat fee.
- Q: What format does the data come back in?
  A: Typed JSON records by default. You can also download the run's dataset as CSV or Excel, or stream it into your own stack.
- Q: Do I need a LinkedIn login to use the API?
  A: No. dataslayer LinkedIn scrapers read public data only — no login, no session and no cookie of yours is used.
- Q: What LinkedIn data can I scrape?
  A: Public profiles, companies, job postings, posts, reactions and comments, plus people and company search with filters.
- Q: Can I build a lead list with it?
  A: Yes. Combine people and company search with profile enrichment to build and filter prospect lists, then export as JSON, CSV or Excel.
- Q: How is it priced?
  A: Per result, at each scraper's published rate through your Apify account. No subscription and no seat minimum.
- Q: Do I need an X (Twitter) login to use the API?
  A: No. Every dataslayer X scraper reads public data only — no login, no session and no cookie of yours is used.
- Q: What X (Twitter) data can I scrape?
  A: Public tweets, profiles, followers, following, replies and comments, and keyword, hashtag or operator-based search results.
- Q: Does it support advanced search operators?
  A: Yes. Search scrapers accept documented advanced operators so you can narrow results by phrase, mention, hashtag or account.
- Q: How is it priced?
  A: Per result, at each scraper's published rate through your Apify account. No subscription and no seat minimum.
- Q: Do I need a Facebook login to use the API?
  A: No. dataslayer Facebook scrapers read public data only — no login, no session and no cookie of yours is used.
- Q: What Facebook data can I scrape?
  A: Public pages, posts, Marketplace listings, Ads Library records, public profiles and keyword page search.
- Q: Can I monitor competitor ads?
  A: Yes. The Ads Library scraper returns public ad records for a page, including creative text and run dates.
- Q: How is it priced?
  A: Per result, at each scraper's published rate through your Apify account. No subscription and no seat minimum.
- Q: Do I need a TikTok login to use the API?
  A: No. dataslayer TikTok scrapers read public data only — no login, no session and no cookie of yours is used.
- Q: What TikTok data can I scrape?
  A: Public profiles, videos, comments, keyword and hashtag search, trending content and single-video details.
- Q: Can I track trending sounds and content?
  A: Yes. Trending and discovery scrapers surface popular content and sounds by topic.
- Q: How is it priced?
  A: Per result, at each scraper's published rate through your Apify account. No subscription and no seat minimum.
- Q: Do I need a Reddit login to use the API?
  A: No. dataslayer Reddit scrapers read public data only — no login, no session and no cookie of yours is used.
- Q: What Reddit data can I scrape?
  A: Public subreddit posts, keyword search results, and full post details including the comment tree.
- Q: Can I monitor a subreddit over time?
  A: Yes. Schedule the subreddit scraper on Apify to collect posts on a recurring basis and store the results.
- Q: How is it priced?
  A: Per result, at each scraper's published rate through your Apify account. No subscription and no seat minimum.
